gates.protects: an unresolved merge is never committed
gates.prove_fires: append a conflict marker to a tracked file, then run the gate; expect exit 1

gates.command: test -z "$(git ls-files | while read -r f; do s=$(wc -c < "$f"); [ "$s" -gt 1048576 ] && echo "$f"; done || true)"
gates.protects: a binary or dataset over 1 MiB does not live in the repository
gates.prove_fires: add a 1.1 MiB file to the index, then run the gate; expect exit 1
